changelog:
WHAT'S NEW
Live TV previews on their own: rest on a channel and it plays in the preview box, with sound. OK goes full screen. The preview no longer shows black on Fire TV.
Plex Discover: Because you watched, Hidden Gems, Surprise Me, Rediscover, and rows by genre and by decade. It sits under Home in the side menu, with Search right below it.
Plex Home: Popular is now Most Watched.

FIXES
Sign-in keyboard on Fire TV: OK opens it, Next moves from Username to Password, Next again puts it away and lands on Sign In. It stays closed.
Dashboard: Billing & subscription no longer sits cut off below the screen.
Live TV Settings: the category list no longer stays highlighted while you are in Settings.
Live TV: the channel list no longer clips the highlighted row at the bottom.
releaseNotes: Version 1.7.4 makes Live TV preview the highlighted channel on its own with OK for full screen, adds Plex Discover for finding something to watch, and fixes the Fire TV sign-in keyboard, the Dashboard's Billing card and the Live TV Settings highlight.
